Annotate features as MS2 fragment ions (Tier 1c / 1c_exp)

annotateISF-PeakAnnotationISF-method.Rd

Dispatched on a PeakAnnotationISF-class object. link to run_isf_annotation().

Phase 1 — Intra-group MS2 fragment (Tier 1c) For each Lib_group, the direct library-match anchor (reference_tier == "Tier1a_AnnoMatch") is used as the ISF parent, provided it has an MS2 spectrum. The anchor may carry any confirmed ESI adduct. Every other co-group feature is tested: if its mzmed matches any fragment ion within ppm_isf and rt_isf_threshold seconds, it receives Tier1c_MS2Fragment.

Phase 2 — RT-gated MS2 fragment (Tier 1c_exp) The same anchor feature searches the full feature pool (features with no Phase 1 assignment) within rt_isf_threshold seconds. Matching features get Tier1c_MS2Fragment_exp.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'PeakAnnotationISF'
annotateISF(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A PeakAnnotationISF-class object.

...

Currently unused.

Value

data.frame with columns: feature_name, mz, rt, parent_feature, parent_mz, parent_rt, matched_fragment_mz, isf_ppm, isf_mda, rt_diff, Lib_group, reference_tier ("1c" or "1c_exp"), annotation_phase ("Phase1_MS2frag" or "Phase2_MS2frag").

See also

createPeakAnnotationISF(), run_isf_annotation(), read_ms2_consensus()
